fixes.fix: Make the approach a real input to the movement model, and stop it eating presses. (1) Move the approach steering ahead of the speed code: just after `if (atk) target *= 0.25;` (line ~59), if C.approach is active compute bearing b = atan2(q.x-P.x, q.z-P.z), set P.moveYaw = b and target = Math.min(PLAYER.run, Math.max(2.2, (d - 1.0) * 3.5) + qSpeed), where qSpeed = q.speed (the ped's own speed, peds.js p.speed). Then make the dy calculation (line 62) use P.moveYaw even when want = 0, and use acc = 13 in line 81 while C.approach. Delete the P.speed/P.yaw writes in the approach block (line 205). (2) End the approach at d < 1.9 instead of 1.55, and let the existing lunge close the last 0.4-1.0 m. (3) Never drop presses: while C.approach is active, don't decrement C.next (line 199), and on approach timeout fire the punch anyway if d < 2.6 (C.next = 0.1) instead of nulling it. (4) Timeout 0.8 -> 1.0 s. Acceptance on punch_walker telemetry: the first hit (hits increments) within 0.75 s (22 frames) of the first press at t15; every press produces a swing (pT resets to 0 four times); sp - real < 0.05 on every approach frame; maxAccel <= 15 m/s^2 from t15 to t40.

Turn the lunge into a step-in, not a 2-frame skate. In the attack start (line ~223), set C.lungeT = MathUtils.clamp((dT - 0.95) / 3.2, 0.12, 0.3). In the lunge block (line ~111), cap lungeV at 4.0 (was 7.0), target 0.95 m instead of 0.9, and also push back when too close: if d < 0.8, lungeV = -(0.85 - d) / 0.1 (back-step, cap -2.5). Seed the legs the same frame: when the lunge starts, set P.animSpeed = Math.max(P.animSpeed, Math.min(lungeV, 2.6)) and set the walk/run action time to the passing pose (see fix 4) so a foot steps forward. Keep ext = clamp((dT - 1.1)/6.5, 0, 0.32) so the impact still waits for the lunge (it ends by 0.3 s <= impact time). Acceptance: punch_approach and punch_walker player real speed <= 4.1 m/s on every frame; no foot moves > 2.0 m/s while within floor + 0.03 m during t50-t95; knockout ped distance at each hits increment between 0.8 and 1.2 m (now 0.69 at t11).

No speed pops or flicker when blocked. (1) Line 177: replace `P.speed = real` with `P.speed = Math.max(real, prev - 14 * dt)` and stop the move this frame (the position is already clamped), so a blocked stop eases out over at most 0.15 s, and also set ch.speed decay through animSpeed. (2) Line 178: drop the `P.speed > 0.3` condition; use `P.speed > 0.05`. (3) Edge probe (lines 76-79): start at dd = 0.25 and use tgt = Math.sqrt(13 * Math.max(0, dd - 0.4)), so the target reaches 0 at the lip (now the floor is 0.8 m/s at dd 0.5). (4) When ok() fails on all three tries (nx, nz both reset) and want > 0.3, set P.edgeHold = true: tgt = 0, P.speed = 0, and keep it until the stick direction changes by more than 0.6 rad. Acceptance: shore t92-t120 has sp monotonic non-increasing to 0 with no alternating frames; sprint_stop and shove maxAccel <= 15 m/s^2 after release; planted-foot slip in shore t92-t120 < 0.2 m/s.

Start from the passing pose so idle -> walk doesn't drag the feet. In Character.update, track this.wasIdle = v < 0.05. On the frame v first exceeds 0.05, set each LOCO action's time to ((this.ph[k] + 0.22) % 1) * duration (just after the left heel strike: left foot planted under the hips, right foot passing, close to the idle stance). Replace wIdle = clamp(1 - v/0.6) with 1 - smoothstep(v, 0.05, 0.9), so the idle weight falls over about 0.15 s at 6 m/s^2, not 0.07 s. Acceptance: run_turns, jump, shore, phone and shove frames t1-t8 have no foot within floor + 0.03 m moving faster than 0.5 m/s, and any foot moving faster than 1.5 m/s is at least 0.05 m above its floor (now 2.5-4.1 m/s at 0-4 cm).

Shorter walk stop and a smoother jog stop. Line 95: walk_stop rate MathUtils.clamp(prev / 0.8, 1.2, 1.6) (now 0.92x for a 1.1 m/s walk). In the ch.trans branch (line 91), add `if (ch.trans && (ch.transT > 0.62 || P.speed < 0.22)) ch.stopTrans(0.2);` and let the normal 8.5 m/s^2 decel finish. For run_stop, low-pass the root speed: rv = lerp(prevRv, transDelta/dt, 0.5), so the 2.87 x4 / 1.24 x6 staircase becomes a ramp. Acceptance: walk telemetry from t66 reaches sp 0 within 16 frames (0.53 s) and <= 0.45 m (now 35 frames); run_turns t114-t132 and side_run stop have no plateau longer than 2 frames and |dsp/dt| <= 14 m/s^2; stop distance from 3.5 m/s is 0.9-1.3 m.

Jump: freeze the gait in the air and reach for the ground on landing. In update(), when this.airW > 0.3 multiply the run/sprint/walk timeScale by (1 - this.airW), so the legs hold the take-off stride instead of cycling at 4-7 m/s in the air. In upperBody, scale the tuck by the ground clearance passed from player.js (ch.airH = P.y - g.y; P.vy < 0): tuck = airW * clamp(airH / 0.35, 0, 1) when descending, so the legs extend in the last 0.1 s. Arms: airborne UpperArm out 0.45 -> 0.2 rad, plus 0.4 rad forward swing on the arm opposite the lead leg. Acceptance: at jump t38 (the onG false -> true frame) min(lf, rf) height <= floor + 0.05 m (now +0.25/+0.59); airborne foot horizontal speed relative to the body < 1.5 m/s for t26-t36.

Bodies on the ground should be stepped over, not be walls. In the downed-ped branch (line ~142), only push out the player when P.speed < 1.0. Above that, apply the stumble once (existing code, P.stumbleT 0.4), then let the player pass with speed *= 0.7 and ch.flinch forward, and skip the positional push while P.stumbleT > 0. Acceptance: shove t32-t60 shows real >= 0.8 * sp on every frame once sp > 1, and the player ends more than 1.0 m past the body by t60.

Tighter fight framing. In updateCamera, replace `dist *= 1 + 0.09 * P.fightK` with dist = lerp(dist, 3.4, P.fightK), and ty -= 0.15 * P.fightK (aim at chest height). Keep the 0.55 rad side swing. Exclude benches and props from the near field: add props to col.segment for camera pull-in only when the hit is within 1.2 m of the lens, or fade bench meshes whose distance to the camera is < 1.5 m (material.opacity 0.35). Acceptance: in punch_walker f017-f028 and knockout f002-f008, the player's bounding box is >= 33% of the frame height (now about 25%); in run_turns f018-f021 no prop covers the player's legs.

Personal space and hit readability. (1) In the idle branch (and when the state is switched to idle) zero p.speed (p.speed = 0 when target is 0 and the state changed this frame), so a ped told to stand doesn't walk 0.7 m into the player (knockout t1-t6). (2) In the walk branch, keep >= 1.1 m from the player: if d2p < 1.1, steer yaw away by 0.8 rad and target *= 0.3. (3) Stagger: scale ch.speed by 1.0 (not 0.8) with reverse, and add a 0.05 m body drop for 0.15 s (ch.body.position.y) so the hit reads at fight-camera distance. Acceptance: knockout ped distance never < 0.8 m before the first hit; punch_walker victim distance grows >= 0.3 m within 10 frames of each hit.

Footsteps during start/stop transitions and haptics. In update(), when this.trans is set, fire onFootstep on the transition clip's heel contacts: track the lower foot per frame and fire when a foot's world y drops within 0.012 m of its stance floor after having been more than 0.03 m above it (latched per foot), instead of skipping on `!this.trans`. In index.js, onPunch 'hit' -> navigator.vibrate?.(kind === 'hook' || ko ? 35 : 18), onPlayerPunched -> 12 ms, and onShove with down -> 25 ms plus G.emit('fx:shake', 0.3). Acceptance: replaying side_run's stop frames gives 2 step events (plant + settle); the shove at t31 triggers a shake.

Approach convergence (lines 201-206). Fire the strike when d < 1.85, not 1.55: the direct path at line 214 already handles gaps up to 1.9 m with the lunge and ext. Use a speed law that out-runs a walking target: const qs = q.speed || 0, ws = Math.min(PLAYER.run + 0.6, Math.max(qs + 1.6, (d - 1.2) * 4)); keep the 13 m/s^2 ramp. Keep one buffered press while approaching: in line 198 set C.approach.queued = (C.approach.queued || 0) + 1 when C.approach is active, and on arrival set C.next = 0.1 and C.comboT = 0.9 if queued > 0, so presses chain into jab -> cross. Target: punch_walker first impact within 0.6 s of the press and 4 presses -> 4 swings, at least 3 hits.

Varied bystander reactions and a witness phone call. In S.scare (line 113), give each ped within r a roll: 55% flee (as now); 25% 'cower' (state 'cower', target 0, ch.guardTarget 1, spine pitch 0.5 via ch.lean.pitch = 0.5, 3-5 s, then flee); 20% 'film' if d > 6 (state 'film', face the incident point, ch.playGesture('phone'), 6 s). In index.js peds.onHit (line 160), when no cop is near, don't setMin(1) immediately: pick the nearest film/cower/ok ped within 25 m (excluding the victim) as p.caller, set state 'call' with callT = 4 and gesture 'phone', and show a red phone icon over them (reuse hud.lockOn styling). When callT hits 0, wanted.setMin(1) and hud.message('POLICE SCANNER', 'Assault reported near ' + zone). If the caller is punched or knocked down first, cancel. With no witness in range, no star.

COLLECT spam and vehicle flip-flop (line 71). Require on foot and fire once: if (!A.spotted && !p.vehicle && m.ch.state === 'ok' && !m.fight && d < 6) { A.spotted = true; m.fight = {...}; m.state = 'fight'; hud.message(...); }. Re-arm the fight only (no message) when !p.vehicle and d < 6 and !m.fight. In peds.js line 201, when player.vehicle is set for the mark (p.isMark), switch to state 'flee' with fleeT 6 instead of 'walk', so the mark runs from your car. Also have J.cancel (line 77) and fail() clear A.car.keep = false and A.mark.isMark = false.

Body pin (lines 142-146). Replace the straight push-back with a lateral slide. Let side = Math.sign((P.x - qp.x) * Math.cos(P.yaw) - (P.z - qp.z) * Math.sin(P.yaw)) || 1. Push only along the right vector (cos yaw, -sin yaw) * side * pen * 0.8, so the player steps round the body. If P.speed < 1.2, skip the push and let the player step over (bodies are low). Keep the stumble at > 2.5 m/s, but once per body: q.stumbledBy = G.t, skip if G.t - q.stumbledBy < 1.5. Target: in shove, the player keeps moving past the body at 2.5 m/s or more after the stumble instead of pinning at d 0.72 with speed < 0.5 for 0.8 s.

Unlock the loop earlier and make HEAT readable. (1) line 44: replace 'if (!missionDone) return' with 'if (!missionDone && !(G.game?.mission?.step === "goto" && G.game.state.t > 90)) return', so street jobs appear 90 s into a session even before the ferry. Pass mission into createJobs instead of going through G.game. (2) HEAT objective (line 32): 'Get 2 stars: knock someone out, then do it again with the cops watching, or nick a cop car.' (3) In index.js peds.onHit (line 160), when wanted.stars >= 1 and the victim is KO'd within 120 m of any wanted.cars or wanted.cops unit, wanted.add(1), so escalation works while a pursuit is closing in.

Phone overlaps. Line 188: body.touch .live { top: auto; bottom: calc(150px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); left: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-left)); } puts it above the stick ghost and off the bars. Add @media (max-height: 430px) { body.touch .live-chat { height: 64px; } }. Line 171: body.touch .objective { top: auto; bottom: calc(14px + env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); max-width: 40vw; font-size: 15px; } puts it bottom-centre between the stick and the button arc. Line 172: body.touch .loc { top: calc(124px + env(safe-area-inset-top)); } puts it under the cash on the right, clear of Shaz's card (x 186-396, y 10-70). In touch.js, use bAction.hidden = !c.inVehicle && !c.canEnter instead of the dim class.

Edge brake precision (lines 76-79). Probe in 0.15 m steps from 0.3 m to reach = 0.35 + P.speed^2 / 11, and subtract one step for safety: tgt = Math.min(tgt, Math.sqrt(11 * Math.max(0, dd - 0.15 - 0.45))). While edge-braking, use acc = 9 instead of 6.5 (line 81: const acc = edgeBrake ? 9 : ...). Also probe along P.moveYaw as well as P.yaw and take the nearer hit, because diagonal approaches cut the corner. Target: sprint_stop reaches the lip at 0.3 m/s or less, with no slide along the lip and no one-frame snap to 0.

Make cops part of melee and escalation. Line 171: player.findTarget = (x, z, yaw, r, ang) => peds.findTarget(x, z, yaw, r, ang, wanted.cops). In peds.findTarget, also iterate the extra list (cops share ch.position and ch.state). In onPunch, when t is a cop: apply ch.flinch, cop.hp -= DMG, knockDown at hp <= 0, and wanted.setMin(Math.max(2, wanted.stars + 1)). Add wanted.cops to player.bodies() peds, so officers are solid and cannot arrest from inside the player. Also make fights two-sided: a ped in p.fight answers every 2nd player punch within 0.35 s (F.cd = Math.min(F.cd, 0.35) after a stagger ends). Randomise DMG to jab 18-30, cross 28-42, hook 40-60, and KO from a hook only when hp < 35, so a KO takes 3-5 hits.

A sprint knockdown counts. Line 174: peds.onShoved = (q, down) => { audio...; if (down) { peds.scare(q.ch.position.x, q.ch.position.z, 10, 4, q); if (copsNear(q.ch.position.x, q.ch.position.z, 30)) wanted.add(1, 'shove'); else if (Math.random() < 0.5) q.fight = q.fight || { t: 0, cd: 1.0, side: 'L' }; } } so a ped who gets up after being flattened sometimes comes back for a fight. In peds.js line 179, keep p.fight when it is set instead of always switching to flee on get-up. In peds.js line 201, when the fight ends for kind 'idle', set state 'idle', not 'walk' (no path, so the ped freezes).

Distinct block feedback and haptics. In player.onPunch (line 175), take the return value r = peds.punched(...). If r === 'block': state.hitstop = 0.03, fx:shake 0.1, audio.play('impact_concrete', { gain: 0.35, rate: 1.6 }), no flesh sound, and a white 'BLOCKED' tick via hud.lockOn flashing grey. Otherwise call navigator.vibrate?.(ko ? 45 : kind === 'hook' ? 30 : 16). In peds.onPlayerPunched (line 184), add navigator.vibrate?.(22). Also fix the vacuous playtest assertion (playtest.json, river edge): replace '!__G.game.player.swimming && !__G.game.player.groundAt?.water' with '!__G.game.player.swimming && __G.game.player.y > 1.5 && __G.game.player.z < -160.0' (promenade y 2.2, lip at z about -160.05 for the x 112 spawn).
